title: Decimal Fractions: Fractions, Decimals, Percentages and Rounding
seo_title: Grade 7 Decimal Fractions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Count forwards and backwards in decimal fractions to at least three decimal places; compare and order decimal fractions to at least 3 decimal places; round off decimal fractions to at least 2 decimal places; recognise equivalence between common fraction, decimal fraction and percentage forms of the same number.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 decimal fractions worksheets: fractions, decimals and percentages, ordering decimals and rounding to decimal places. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: Line up the commas to compare.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Fraction to decimal: divide the numerator by the denominator. 38 = 3 ÷ 8 = 0,375.
  • Decimal to fraction: use the place value. 0,45 = 45100 = 920.
  • Decimal to percentage: × 100. 0,375 = 37,5%.
  • To round to 2 decimal places, look at the third decimal digit.

Examples

Example

Order 0,7; 0,65; 0,705

0,700; 0,650; 0,705

Answer: 0,65; 0,7; 0,705

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Longer is bigger0,65 < 0,7.
3/8 as 3,8Divide: 3 ÷ 8.
The wrong digitLook one place to the right.
